summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall script invokes ensurePlatformBinary, which downloads a tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, extracts it, chmods the contained binary to 0755, and installs it as the package's CLI. The HTTPS request is made with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate verification, and no hash or signature check gates the extracted bytes before they become executable. The download base is also overridable via the ONECODE_TGZ_DOWNLOAD_BASE environment variable with no allowlist. Because the destination is a bare IP rather than a publisher-owned domain, TLS is unverified, and integrity is not checked, any on-path attacker or anyone able to control that IP can substitute arbitrary code that executes on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
